verdict: Best strategy: Independent agents (Independent agents · PPO): 109 s lost per vehicle on average, -52% against today's fixed timers.

Your two strategies head to head: central wins 0 of 16 scenarios, independent wins 16.
Independent vs neighbour-aware: independent wins 11 of 16 scenarios, neighbour-aware 5. Hearing the neighbours adds little on average here.
Against the best classic rule (max-pressure, no learning): Independent agents, Neighbour-aware agents clearly beat it. Central brain with sub-agents only ties it (137 s vs 138 s).

Does the central brain only need more data? With 4× the training it loses 140 s instead of 137 s (+2%), still +28% behind the best strategy: the limit is the design (one model choosing 4^12 joint actions from one shared reward), not the amount of data.
